entities.summary: TALCO Arena is a multi-use stadium in Tursunzoda, Tajikistan. It is currently used mostly for football matches and serves as the home of Regar-TadAZ Tursunzoda of the Tajik League. The stadium has a capacity of 13 770 people. Until 2017 it was called the stadium "Metallurg".
